deleteProjectConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This will remove all chapters, narrators, terminals, and containers. The original repository files will not be affected.

commandsDesc: Define slash commands available to all narrators in this narraflow. NarraFlow commands override user commands with the same name.
commandRunBashFirstDesc: When enabled, using this command runs the Bash command below via the /bash flow before sending the prompt to AI. The Bash result is included in the same AI turn context.
commandBashCommandPlaceholder: e.g. git status --short. Supports {{input}} and parameter placeholders.
commandPromptPlaceholder: Enter the prompt text. Use {{input}} as a placeholder.
commandEmpty: No narraflow commands. Add one to get started.
commandDuplicateName: A command with this name already exists
commandInvalidName: Command name can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores
routinesDesc: Enable or disable built-in commands and skills for this narraflow. Override the global setting per routine.
routinesUnsupportedDesc: This backend runtime does not support project-level routine overrides.
skillsDesc: Skills are reusable instruction sets that provide domain-specific knowledge to narrators. Create and edit project skills here; new skills are saved to .narrafork/skills/<name>/SKILL.md by default.
skillsEmpty: No skills found. Create a project skill to get started.
proxyDomainDesc: Base domain for container proxy subdomains. Each container port gets a subdomain like {chapterId}-{service}-{port}.{domain}.
proxyDomainHint: Requires wildcard DNS: *.{domain} → server IP. For local dev, use *.localhost or configure dnsmasq.
proxyDomainInvalid: Please enter a valid domain (e.g. dev.example.com, without http:// or paths)
projectWhitelistDirsDesc: Directories auto-allowed for narrators in this project.
projectBlacklistDirsDesc: Directories blocked for narrators in this project.
projectCommandWhitelistDesc: Commands auto-allowed for narrators in this project.
projectCommandBlacklistDesc: Commands auto-denied for narrators in this project.
requireReviewBeforeMergeDesc: When enabled, chapters must have an approved review before they can be merged.
authRequiredMessage: This repository requires authentication. Please enter your credentials.

visibilityHint.public: Any signed-in user can reach this project.
